Authorization code flow with S256 PKCE
nodes.rationale: Public SPA client with exact redirect URI and CORS origin; implicit and password grants disabled

nodes.label: AMR mapper from completed authenticator executions
nodes.rationale: pwd/mfa assigned only from actual completed steps; no unconditional MFA claim, evidence expires in 30 minutes

nodes.label: Temporary password-only development login
nodes.rationale: Enabled because domain-managed clock drifted ~67 seconds; limited to bootstrap admin, loopback, 8-hour expiry, never fake MFA claims

nodes.label: Tenant provisioning (bank Flyway migrations, lease, attempt fencing)
nodes.rationale: Attempt IDs fence stale workers; advisory lock prevents concurrent provisioning; identity reservation survives failure so DB cannot go to another tenant

nodes.label: External JWT issuer authentication (RS256)
nodes.rationale: No local password, test issuer or shared-secret backdoor; memberships keyed by tenant+issuer+subject so headers cannot grant access

nodes.label: Tenant lifecycle: Requested -> Provisioning -> Active -> Suspended

nodes.rationale: Tokens held only in memory; PKCE state in session storage; no silent refresh or offline access

CBS session policy (idle timeout, max session age, admin MFA age)
nodes.rationale: Every request re-checks staff record and session in PostgreSQL; store failure denies access

nodes.label: Staff registration linked to provider subject
Approval Inbox (maker-checker)
nodes.rationale: Changes do not touch live records until a different administrator approves; maker cannot approve own request

nodes.label: STALE approval on changed target version
Currency precision and BigDecimal rounding modes
nodes.rationale: Precision from Java runtime currency data; never binary floating point

nodes.label: Bank BCP 47 languages and personal UI language preference
Business calendar (timezone, business date, weekends, holidays)
nodes.rationale: Business date only moves forward; evaluated as local dates to avoid DST assumptions; no midnight scheduler

nodes.label: Chart account (platform.chart_account, Flyway V6)
nodes.rationale: Code, category, normal balance, kind and parent immutable to prevent cycles and silent reclassification

nodes.label: Bank configuration version serialization
nodes.rationale: Any intervening bank/chart change makes older pending requests STALE, deliberately serializing config changes per bank

nodes.label: Ledger delivery outbox worker (30s, batches of 20)
nodes.rationale: No atomic transaction across control and bank DBs; request receipts make retries idempotent after lost acknowledgement

nodes.label: Manual journal posting (bank.journal, bank.journal_line, bank.ledger_balance; bank V3)
Full linked journal reversal
nodes.rationale: Evidence immutable: posted journals never updated; one reversal per original, reversal of reversal rejected

nodes.label: Two-transaction posting with receipt-based acknowledgement recovery
Reconciliation report (turnover comparison)
nodes.rationale: Debit and credit compared separately so equal net balances cannot conceal turnover drift; reports without repairing

nodes.label: Single REPEATABLE READ read-only report transaction
Business day close (DAY_CLOSE action, control V9, bank V4)
nodes.rationale: Seals accounting dates via trigger; bank commits first then control acknowledges, so lost ack is idempotently retried
